title: Finite-free retracts of affine model terms
statement: For each integer degree, the transported term of the explicit affine finite-free model is a retract of a finite free localized structure-sheaf module when K_n is finite free.

source.place: Tag 068C, affine finite free resolution argument

proof.text: Apply the finite-free term isomorphism and take its hom and inv as inclusion and projection; the hom-inv identity is the required composite.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_finite_free_model_retracts {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (U : Y.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U)
    (K : ChainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (Γ(Y, U) : Type u)) ℕ)
    (hfree : ∀ n, Module.Free (Γ(Y, U) : Type u) (K.X n))
    (hfinite : ∀ n, Module.Finite (Γ(Y, U) : Type u) (K.X n)) :
    ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ m : ℕ,
      ∃ (ι : (affineFiniteFreeModelComplex U hU K).X n ⟶
          SheafOfModules.free
            (R := (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin m)))
        (π : SheafOfModules.free
            (R := (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin m)) ⟶
          (affineFiniteFreeModelComplex U hU K).X n),
        ι ≫ π = 𝟙 _
